name: certifications-explained
title: Certifications explained
description: Labels in plain words: what each certification means, who issues it, its number and where to verify it, as cards with a description list.
docs: Pass certifications (an id, a name, an issuer, a meaning in one plain sentence, and optionally a number, since, a verifyHref and a mark) and a footnote. Each card has the name as its heading with the issuer under it, and a description list so the facts read as pairs. The number is set in monospace, a since that is a day is written in the locale and time zone you pass, and a fact you leave out is simply not shown. The Verify link opens in a new tab and says so to screen readers. No seal image is required: without a mark, a typographic one is drawn from the name. The columns follow the number of labels: one is a single card, two or four sit in pairs, and any other number fills three columns on a wide block, so no column is left empty. The block has no state and renders on the server. Words are translated through labels.
